LAUNCH COMPLETE
Capsule clear.
Atmospheric dispersal active.<New>No further capsule available.<New><Elly>
"The nanomachines... They
should be spreading by now."<Close>

<Elly>
"Wait..."<New><Emeralda>
"Elly...? What's wrong?"<New><Elly>
"The room... it is changing.
Two officers are at the
console. I can hear them..."<New><Emeralda>
"Emeralda sees no one.
The room is empty."<Close>

LAUNCH DIRECTOR
"Directive 0320 confirmed.
Target data is loaded.
The Prime Minister has
authorized release."<Close>

SYSTEMS OFFICER
"The warning net contradicts
itself. We have no confirmed
enemy launch. If we fire
now... we begin it."<Close>

LAUNCH DIRECTOR
"And they will answer.
Every major city will be
lost... ours included."<Close>

MIANG
"Do not blame yourself.
You did everything possible
to preserve the peace."<Close>

SYSTEMS OFFICER
"Fallout projections exceed
every shelter limit. Once we
open the banks, there is
no recall."<Close>

MIANG
"That is why the Prime
Minister entrusted this to
you. He knows you will
protect them."<Close>

LAUNCH DIRECTOR
"Protect them...?
There may be no one left
to protect."<Close>

MIANG
"If you hesitate, the enemy
will choose for you.
Is that what you want?"<Close>

SYSTEMS OFFICER
"All four authority points
accepted. Cradles are open.
Director... we need your
final order."<Close>

LAUNCH DIRECTOR
"...Open the banks.
Execute Directive 0320."<Close>

<Emeralda>
"Elly..."<New><Elly>
(Why does this feel so
familiar?)<New><Emeralda>
"Elly?"<New><Elly>
(I remember that...from a
dream?)<New><Elly>
"But no matter, we have a
job to do."<Close>

<Emeralda>
"Was it a dream?"<New><Elly>
"It felt like one of my
dreams... but the memory
was not mine."<New><Elly>
"The archives name Miang.
That voice was hers. This
was her memory."<New><Emeralda>
"But Miang did not give
order."<New><Elly>
"No. She turned every doubt
into another reason to fire.
She made the choice feel
like their own."<Close>

<Emeralda>
"And now... we use the same
machine?"<New><Elly>
"Yes. Once, it was used to
destroy life. Now... we will
use it to heal."<New><Elly>
"The Limiter was forced upon
them. We can give back what
was taken."<New><Emeralda>
"Then... let us do it."<New><Elly>
"The console is ready. We
will activate it when we are
prepared."<Close>

<Citan>
"Elly! You have the capsule
connected, then?"<New><Elly>
"Yes. But I can't get the
guidance to hold steady."<New><Citan>
"Let me see... I can adjust
it from here. Will you take
the launch controls?"<New><Elly>
"I'm ready."<New>LAUNCH SEQUENCE ARMED
Magnetic banks synchronized.
Capsule ascent ready.
Accelerator charging.<New><Citan>
"There... The course is
holding. Elly, now!"<New><Elly>
"Please... let it reach
everyone."<New><Emeralda>
"Go!"<Close>

MIANG
"You did what was
necessary."<Close>
